$comment: Registry of dictionary sources consumed by tools/fetch_sources.py and tools/build_dict.py. 'redistribute': false means the licence does not allow shipping the derived pack in a published extension; the fetch script refuses those unless --allow-nonredistributable is passed.

sources.name: Berntsen's Marathi-English Dictionary
sources.description: Concise modern Marathi-English dictionary with part-of-speech labels.
sources.attribution: A. M. Berntsen, Marathi-English Dictionary (1920). Digitised and converted by the indic-dict project.

sources.name: Vaze's Marathi-English Dictionary
sources.attribution: Vaze, Marathi-English Dictionary (1911). Digitised and converted by the indic-dict project.

sources.name: Molesworth's Marathi-English Dictionary
sources.description: The classic exhaustive Marathi-English dictionary (long, scholarly entries).
sources.attribution: J. T. Molesworth, A Dictionary of Marathi and English (1831/1857). Digitised and converted by the indic-dict project.

sources.name: Wiktionary Marathi (English glosses)
sources.description: Machine-readable extract of English Wiktionary's Marathi entries.
sources.attribution: Wiktionary contributors, via Wiktextract (Tatu Ylonen) / kaikki.org.

sources.name: Wiktionary Hindi (English glosses)
sources.description: Machine-readable extract of English Wiktionary's Hindi entries - the main Hindi-English pack.
sources.attribution: Wiktionary contributors, via Wiktextract (Tatu Ylonen) / kaikki.org.

sources.name: Shabdasagar (Hindi-Hindi)
sources.description: Shyamsundar Das's monolingual Hindi dictionary, 1916-1929. Hindi definitions, no English.
sources.attribution: Shyamsundar Das, Hindi Shabdasagar (1916-1929). Digitised and converted by the indic-dict project.

sources.name: Bahri's Advanced Learner's Hindi-English Dictionary
sources.description: High-quality learner's dictionary with romanisation and usage examples.
sources.attribution: Hardev Bahri, Rajpal Advanced Learner's Hindi-English Dictionary (Rajpal & Sons).

sources.name: Chaturvedi & Tiwari's Practical Hindi-English Dictionary
sources.description: Compact Hindi-English dictionary with transliteration and grammatical labels.
sources.attribution: Mahendra Chaturvedi & Bhola Nath Tiwari, A Practical Hindi-English Dictionary (National Publishing House, 1970).

sources.name: Raghu Vira's English-Hindi Dictionary of Government and Educational Words
sources.description: English to Hindi dictionary of administrative, scientific and educational terminology.
sources.license: Government of India publication - public domain
sources.attribution: Dr. Raghu Vira, A Comprehensive English-Hindi Dictionary of Government and Educational Words and Phrases.
